description.zh: 常用的画布工具和 3D 效果：轴网、坐标系，下雨、下雪、雾、萤火虫和夜景
description.en: Common canvas tools and 3D effects: a structural grid, a coordinate system, rain, snow, fog, fireflies and night

grid.description: A structural grid over the current level's walls: numbered axes along x, lettered along y, every `spacing` mm from the origin (by default the walls' north-west corner). Its intersections snap furniture and walls when `snap` is on. Move the origin with originX/originY (mm), or drag its handle.

originX.description: x of the origin, mm; null for the walls' west edge

originY.description: y of the origin, mm; null for the walls' north edge

snap.description: Whether the intersections snap furniture and walls

axes.description: A coordinate system on the current level: an x axis pointing east and a y axis pointing south (as the plan's), from an origin (by default the walls' north-west corner), `length` mm long, with a tick every `tick` mm. The origin and the ticks snap furniture and walls when `snap` is on. Move the origin with originX/originY (mm), or drag its handle.

tick.description: Distance between ticks, mm; 0 for none

originX.description: x of the origin, mm; null for the walls' west edge

originY.description: y of the origin, mm; null for the walls' north edge

snap.description: Whether the origin and the ticks snap furniture and walls

rain.description: Rain falling over a space (or the whole site) in the 3D view, under an overcast sky with a little mist. Tune with intensity (light drizzle to downpour) and wind.

space.description: Spaces by id or name, or words in their names (庭院 covers every space whose name has it); empty for the whole site

wind.description: Wind from west to east, m/s (negative blows west)

snow.description: Snow drifting down over a space (or the whole site) in the 3D view, under an overcast sky. Tune with intensity and wind.

space.description: Spaces by id or name, or words in their names (庭院 covers every space whose name has it); empty for the whole site

wind.description: Wind from west to east, m/s (negative blows west)

fog.description: Mist over the whole scene in the 3D view. Tune with density.

fireflies.description: Fireflies drifting low over a space (best a yard or garden) at dusk in the 3D view. Tune with intensity.

space.description: Spaces by id or name, or words in their names (庭院 covers every space whose name has it); empty for the whole site

night.description: Night in the 3D view: a dark sky and warm lights on in the largest rooms (up to 8), so the windows glow. Tune with how bright the lights are.

brightness.description: How bright the room lights are, 0.1 to 1
